services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Join us at the Playhouse this summer for weekly camps for ages 4-18. We look forward to an unforgettable experience together! Summer camps offer kids new experiences, connections with guest artists, and a range of unique programs. We’re excited to share our offerings early so you can plan ahead and find the best fit for your family. Scholarships are available for families needing assistance. See below for details. In celebration of David Ray's lifelong dedication to education and his love of community theatre, we have created this fund to ensure our programs are accessible to everyone in our community, providing universal access to the arts.
